name: Cell tower
simple: A mast with clever antennas. It talks to all the phones nearby by radio and sends their parcels on through a glass thread.
technical: A 5G base station (gNB): massive-MIMO antenna panels, the radio scheduler, and a fibre backhaul that tunnels user traffic (GTP-U) to the mobile core.

up.simple: The tower takes your parcel off the radio and puts it in a tunnel envelope addressed to the mobile core.
up.technical: The gNB ends the radio link (NR) and tunnels the packet in GTP-U to the UPF; the TEID names this phone’s session.

down.simple: The tower unpacks the tunnel envelope and sends your parcel to your phone by radio.
down.technical: The gNB ends the GTP-U tunnel (the TEID says which phone) and schedules the packet on the radio (NR).
